notes: Row-level owner evidence for SRD inventory rows whose installed Surface class-feature records are exercised by the character-sheet runtime. This manifest records executable Character Sheet projection evidence; it is not authored provenance.

srd521:classes/barbarian:level-1:class-f.profile: Character Sheet Armor Class base formula runtime
srd521:classes/barbarian:level-1:class-f.summary: Barbarian Unarmored Defense is read from the installed Surface class-feature record and projected into a Character Sheet Armor Class base formula when the build is not wearing armor. The projection keeps Shield handling separate and supports explicit base-formula selection when multiple class-feature formulas are available.

srd521:classes/monk:level-1:class-featur.profile: Character Sheet Armor Class base formula runtime
srd521:classes/monk:level-1:class-featur.summary: Monk Unarmored Defense is read from the installed Surface class-feature record and projected into a Character Sheet Armor Class base formula only while the build is not wearing armor and not wielding a Shield. The projection supports explicit base-formula selection when multiple class-feature formulas are available.

srd521:classes/wizard:level-1:class-feat.profile: Character Sheet Rest and Spell Slot Recovery runtime
srd521:classes/wizard:level-1:class-feat.summary: Character Sheet rest completion models Short Rest Hit Dice spending, Long Rest spent Hit Dice recovery, Pact Slot recovery, ordinary Spell Slot recovery, and Wizard Arcane Recovery as distinct runtime facts. Wizard Arcane Recovery is read from the installed Surface class-feature record and applied during Short Rest completion as a distinct ordinary Spell Slot refund; the runtime enforces feature ownership, the Short Rest trigger, once-per-Long-Rest feature use, half-Wizard-level rounded-up recovery budget, level 6+ exclusion, and expended-slot ceiling.
